purpose: Teach: 精通/バネ/急上昇/弁理/全編/特段/ジャッジ/発進

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪手口に精通された捜査員もおられますね
lines.en: The police force certainly has investigators well-versed in criminal methodology.
lines.style: Conversational, observational tone. Light, appreciative lift at the end of the sentence. Respectful but not deferential. Steady pacing with natural breath pauses.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、若手警官はバネを持ってかれますね
lines.en: Young police officers really do have that drive and energy, don't they.
lines.style: Warm, slightly admiring observation. Gentle lilt upward at the question tag. Relaxed pacing. The tone of someone noticing something genuine without making a fuss about it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪件数の急上昇の対策を立てられますね
lines.en: And the police work hard to respond when crime rates spike like that.
lines.style: Thoughtful nod in the voice. Moderate pace, clear emphasis on 'work hard.' Not urgent—calm recognition of serious effort. Trailing downward at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、知的財産関連の弁理士とも連携されますね
lines.en: The police collaborate with patent attorneys on intellectual property cases too.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, informative. Light emphasis on 'collaborate.' Steady, professional pacing. The tone of someone stating something factual and sensible.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、報告書の全編を確認されますね
lines.en: They make sure to review all sections of the reports thoroughly.
lines.style: Straightforward, businesslike tone. Slight emphasis on 'all.' Unhurried pace. The voice of someone confirming careful procedure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、特段の警備が必要な式典もありますね
lines.en: Some events really do require special security arrangements, don't they.
lines.style: Measured, acknowledging. Gentle question-tag lilt at the end. Calm, steady pacing. The recognition of necessity without alarm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、現場のジャッジは公平に下されますね
lines.en: And decisions at the scene are made fairly and impartially.
lines.style: Firm but not stern. Clear emphasis on 'fairly.' Steady, confident pacing. The tone of someone stating a principle that matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、緊急車両の発進体制を整備されてますね
lines.en: The emergency response system is well-organized and ready to deploy.
lines.style: Direct, assured tone. Slight emphasis on 'well-organized.' Brisk but controlled pacing. The clarity of someone speaking with confidence about practical preparedness.
